notes: Enumeration only - no rent/availability data was collected, per instructions. Counts labeled 'co_community_count_seen' reflect what was directly verified via WebFetch or a specific named list in search results; where a page could not be fetched (403/404/SSL error/JS-only shell) or only exposed a search widget, count is null and the note field explains what could be confirmed instead via search. Several large operators (Willow Bridge, Avenue5, Asset Living, Steadfast, Monarch, Waterton, Weidner, Embrey) almost certainly have more CO communities than the 'seen' count reflects, because their sites are either JS/interactive-search-driven or the specific listing subpage could not be resolved; the true additional-community figure is likely higher than the conservative estimate below. Two entities were flagged as likely duplicates of authorities already implied by the candidate list: Maiker Housing Partners is the d/b/a of Adams County Housing Authority (counted once). Denver Housing Authority, Boulder Housing Partners, Aurora Housing Authority, Foothills Regional Housing (Jefferson County), and Maiker/Adams County are all public housing authorities, not private operators, but were included per the task's explicit candidate list. All housing-authority and nonprofit portfolio pages were server-rendered and readable directly via WebFetch, in contrast to several market-rate national operators (Monarch, Weidner, Waterton, Asset Living, Trammell Crow) whose listing/search pages returned 403s, SSL errors, or bare JS shells.
